1. Ensure the Docker environment has `node:22-bookworm` available locally (pull if missing) before running probes.
2. Re-run the `probe_process` action with the same script and arguments to verify the exit status is now 143 (indicating the child process received SIGINT but the relay failed to map it to 130).
